title: When Errors Become Memories: Causal Pathway Tracing in Multi-Turn Memory-Augmented LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.30198v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-term memory enables large language models (LLMs) to preserve and reuse information across interactions, but it can also turn localized errors into persistent risks. Existing work mainly evaluates whether memory systems store and retrieve information correctly, leaving limited understanding of how errors propagate across responses, memory states, and future interactions. We propose a structural causal model (SCM)-based framework for cross-turn error propagation in memory-augmented LLMs. We model user questions, model responses, and memory states as a dynamic causal process, and identify two entry pathways: internal memory updating and external question feedback. By intervening on these pathways, we construct four counterfactual trajectories and quantify their downstream effects and interaction. Error influence is evaluated at four levels: memory retention, natural responses, targeted diagnostic probing, and probability-level error pr

translated_title: 当错误成为记忆：多轮记忆增强大语言模型中的因果路径追踪
translated_abstract: 长期记忆使大语言模型（LLM）能够在多次交互中保存和复用信息，但它也可能使局部错误演变为持续性风险。现有工作主要评估记忆系统能否正确存储和检索信息，而对错误如何在响应、记忆状态和未来交互之间传播的理解仍然有限。我们提出了一个基于结构因果模型（SCM）的框架，用于研究记忆增强大语言模型中的跨轮次错误传播。我们将用户问题、模型响应和记忆状态建模为一个动态因果过程，并识别出两条错误进入路径：内部记忆更新和外部问题反馈。通过对这些路径进行干预，我们构建了四条反事实轨迹，并量化其下游影响及相互作用。错误影响在四个层面进行评估：记忆留存、自然响应、针对性诊断探测以及概率层面的错误传播。
tldr: 该论文提出一个基于结构因果模型的框架，通过干预内部记忆更新与外部问题反馈两条错误进入路径构建反事实轨迹，系统量化了错误在记忆增强大语言模型多轮交互中的传播机制及其在记忆留存、自然响应、诊断探测和概率层面四个层面的下游影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structural causal model-based framework that constructs four counterfactual trajectories by intervening on two error entry pathways—internal memory updating and external question feedback—to systematically quantify how errors propagate across turns in memory-augmented LLMs at four levels: memory retention, natural responses, diagnostic probing, and probability-level propagation.
